evidence.ACL: Interstitial hyperintensity in the ACL, in favor of grade 1 injury
evidence.Medial Meniscus: Linear signal intensity in posterior horn of medial meniscus, without significant extending into the surface, in favor of grade 2 intrasubstance signal of posterior horn of medial meniscus
evidence.Medial OA: Wearing cartilage in the knee joint and spur formation in the posterior tibial plateau and fluid accumulation, Osteoarthritis noted
evidence.Lateral OA: Wearing cartilage in the knee joint and spur formation in the posterior tibial plateau and fluid accumulation, Osteoarthritis noted
evidence.PF OA: Hyperintensity and wearing the cartilage of patellofemoral joint and spur formation, more prominent at lateral facet, reflecting osteoarthritis.
evidence.Effusion: Joint effusion and medial and lateral patellar plicae.
